rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's Ratings has affirmed Hurley Medical Center's (MI) Ba1 revenue bond rating. At the same time, Moody's revised the outlook to positive from stable. Hurley had about $67 million in debt outstanding at fiscal year-end 2024.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Upgraded from Ba1 to Baa3 (one notch into investment grade)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Strengthened financial profile; strong payer mix; continued volume improvement.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: 'Hurley Medical Center's rating was upgraded to Baa3 from Ba1 by Moody's. The upgrade is driven by the Flint, Mich.-based system's strengthened financial profile, including a fundamentally strong payer mix and continued volume improvement.' Date: Dec 2024 per user note.

moodys.citation_text: Baa3 in effect post-Dec 2024 upgrade; outlook stable post-upgrade.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's upgraded Hurley Medical Center from Ba1 to Baa3 in December 2024 — a crucial one-notch move that brought Hurley back into investment-grade territory. Preceded by Positive outlook revision earlier in 2024. UPGRADE.
